page: Amazon Web Services i3en.2xlarge is a storage-optimized instance built on the Nitro hypervisor. It features an Intel Xeon 8259CL x86_64 processor operating at 3.1 GHz, configured with 8 vCPUs across 4 physical cores with hyper-threading enabled. The processor includes a 35 MB L3 cache and supports AVX, AVX-512F, AES, BMI2, and FMA instruction sets. The instance is equipped with 64.0 GB of DDR4 memory running at 3 GHz, providing a high memory-to-core ratio of 8.0 GB per vCPU.

A defining feature of this instance is its bundled local storage, consisting of 5000 GB of NVMe SSD capacity. This massive local storage capacity is paired with an 8 Gbps baseline network bandwidth. In benchmark evaluations, the instance demonstrates average multi-core CPU performance, average memory bandwidth reaching 381.66 GB/sec for cached small-block reads, and average performance in database operations and static web serving. However, single-core CPU performance, single-threaded compression, and LLM inference tasks fall into the weak category, indicating that the hardware is optimized for high-throughput parallel storage operations rather than raw single-threaded compute speed.

From a cost-efficiency perspective, the i3en.2xlarge provides high resource density, particularly regarding local NVMe SSD storage and memory capacity relative to the vCPU count. This makes it a highly specialized option where local high-speed storage is the primary requirement, offsetting the lower single-core compute efficiency. The instance is best suited for storage-intensive workloads, including distributed databases, transactional databases, data warehousing, and high-throughput static web serving.
